# Ricardo Maio

> Ricardo Maio is a Cape Town entrepreneur who builds the systems that let a business grow past one location. He runs five companies across franchising, electrical wholesale, urban farming, business digitisation and food manufacturing.

Canonical: https://targetpraks.github.io/ricardomaio-profile/

## Companies

- **Infinity Brands** (Franchising) — Franchise development, and the systems that scale it. <https://infinitybrands.co.za>
- **ACDC Express** (Wholesale) — Electrical wholesale and lighting, with branches nationwide. <https://acdcexpress.com>
- **The Local Farmer** (Agri) — Sustainable urban farming for restaurants and retailers. <https://thelocalfarmer.co.za>
- **INFX Solutions** (Technology) — Business digitisation — the group's Zoho partner. <https://infxsolutions.co.za>
- **Papa Pasta** (Food) — Authentic durum semolina pasta for retail shelves and industrial kitchens. <https://mafgateways.com/blank-7>
